BaseExceptionGroups became part of standard Python in version 3.11. They are not bound to asyncio TaskGroup in any way. The documentation is here: <https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html?highlight=exceptiongroup> .

Regarding your question 2, within the TaskGroup context you always have the option of creating a task using `asyncio.create_task` or `loop.create_task` .
